e_shram.full_name: e-Shram National Database of Unorganized Workers
benefits: Accident cover up to ₹2 lakh via linkage
Gateway to other welfare schemes (PMSBY, PM-SYM)
Job notifications and skill development opportunities

registration.process: Online at eshram.gov.in or via Common Service Centre

e_shram.target_group: Unorganized workers including gig workers, platform workers, construction workers, domestic workers, agricultural workers
e_shram.notes: Mandatory prerequisite for accessing other gig worker welfare schemes

benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000/month after age 60
Family pension (50% to spouse in case of death)
Voluntary exit with interest on contribution

registration.process: Online via Jan Suraksha Portal or Common Service Centre

pm_sym.target_group: Unorganized workers with monthly income below ₹15,000
risk_factors: Auto-debit failure leads to contribution lapse
Requires sustained monthly contribution for full benefit
pm_sym.notes: Joint reasoning with Budget Agent required: Check if user's savings_rate_recommendation can sustain monthly contribution for minimum 4 stable weeks

pmsby.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
critical_alerts: Coverage lapses for FULL YEAR if balance insufficient on debit date
Re-enrollment possible but requires fresh consent
No refund for partial year coverage

registration.process: Through bank or via e-Shram linkage

pmsby.claim_process: Through nominated bank with death/disability certificate
pmsby.notes: HIGH PRIORITY for gig workers due to occupation risk. Proactive nudge 14 days before debit is CRITICAL.

pmjjby.full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
pmjjby.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits: Nominee receives sum on death from any cause
critical_alerts: Coverage lapses if balance insufficient on June 1st
Higher premium compared to PMSBY (₹436 vs ₹20)
Cannot enroll after age 50 (but can continue till 55 if already enrolled)

registration.process: Through bank branch or online banking
registration.renewal: Auto-renewal if balance sufficient on June 1st

pmjjby.notes: Consider PMSBY first for gig workers due to lower premium and higher occupation risk. PMJJBY provides all-cause death cover.

apy.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits: Spouse receives same pension amount after subscriber's death
Nominee receives corpus if both die
Government co-contribution: 50% of contribution or ₹1,000/year (whichever is lower) for 5 years

government_co_contribution.amount: 50% of contribution OR ₹1,000/year, whichever is lower
government_co_contribution.discontinued_after: FY 2021-22 for new enrollments (verify current status)

apy.target_group: Young workers aged 18-40 who are not income tax payers
apy.comparison_with_pm_sym: APY offers flexible pension amounts (₹1,000-₹5,000) vs PM-SYM fixed ₹3,000; APY may have higher contribution
apy.notes: Better suited for younger gig workers with stable income. Joint reasoning with Budget Agent: Check if volatility allows sustained monthly commitment.

karnataka.registration: Karnataka Gig Workers Welfare Board portal

state_welfare_boards.notes: State-specific schemes vary. User must be queried for current state of residence. Cess is typically deducted at platform level (user may not notice).

code_on_social_security_2020.full_name: Code on Social Security, 2020 - Gig Worker Classification

classification_criteria.gig_worker_definition: Person performing work or services outside traditional employer-employee relationship

eligibility_threshold_option_1.description: 90 days active with ONE aggregator platform

verification.required_proof: Platform registration certificate or payout statements
verification.aggregators_covered: Swiggy, Zomato, Uber, Ola, Urban Company, Dunzo, others

code_on_social_security_2020.notes: CRITICAL for scheme eligibility. Synthetic data includes boundary test users (user_0001 to user_0012) specifically for this criteria.

eligibility_decision_tree.description: Sequential eligibility check flow for Scheme Agent

steps.if_yes: Not eligible for most gig worker schemes

steps.check: Is user an income tax payer?
steps.if_yes: Not eligible for most gig worker schemes

steps.check: Has user completed 90 days (single platform) OR 120 days (multi-platform)?
steps.if_no: Not classified as gig worker under Code 2020; wait until threshold met
steps.if_yes: User is eligible gig worker. Proceed to scheme-specific checks.

steps.if_no: RECOMMEND e-Shram registration first (gateway to other schemes)
steps.if_yes: User can access PM-SYM, PMSBY, state boards

steps.check: Check age-specific eligibility for each scheme

affordability_joint_reasoning_logic.description: How Scheme Agent collaborates with Budget Agent to determine affordability

calculation.stability_requirement: Income should be stable (volatility < 30%) for at least 4 weeks before auto-debit enrollment

example.stability_check: volatility 22% (moderate) → RECOMMEND waiting for 4 stable weeks before enrollment
example.final_recommendation: Eligible and affordable, but defer enrollment until income stabilizes
